note: Simon Thomas posed the conjecture in his 1991 paper 'Reducts of the Random Graph' published in The Journal of Symbolic Logic, Vol. 56, No. 1, pp. 176-181. The conjecture asks whether every countable homogeneous structure with a finite relational language has finitely many first-order reducts (up to interdefinability).
